notices.payload: Only IDs, enums, money/currency and UTC deadlines. No need text, vendor, traveller, payee or receipt bytes.

runtime_registration.ready: Owned AppConfig registers two notification sources and canonical frozen-project reader only when Events/R runtimes are active. G installs reminder sources, optional request port, live payout preflight, cancellation and upload binding adapters, and literal routes.

retention_registration.lifetime: Always importable, including tombstoned runtime; exposed on AppConfig.retention_provider. G composes into its literal PLANS/BY_KEY/catalogue/object dispatches.

source_boundaries.crypto: prepared_boundary holds lock-only source gate during prepare_tenant_key before domain transaction/row locks; shared tenant_key_context only
source_boundaries.workers: tasks.sweep_one and defer_failed_work source/fences/event/host; source-frozen discovery excluded and rechecked
source_boundaries.lock_order: source -> prepared tenant crypto -> global/tenant/account fences -> series/event -> sorted host/collaborator tenants -> authority -> programme -> pool -> request -> award -> claim -> obligation -> sorted children
source_boundaries.receipt_override: Pre-discover affected events/series/owners/trusted hash; sorted event/programme/pool/request/award/claim/core obligation locks before ReceiptUse. Changed unpaid allocations are held before append; paid allocations cannot be reassigned.

object_fields.finance_receipts: Core FinanceAttachment staging_key/object_key + version/generation/retention locators; selected by object_capture.attachments; never deleted by module purge
object_fields.capture: object_capture.capture full custodial only; redacted omits bytes; core capture_attachment is authoritative

portable_status: Implemented portable.transform/remap_structured; preserve amounts, commitments, accepted caps and immutable history; drop work coordination; pause imported programme until explicit checked finance reconciliation; target envelopes through in-memory custody callback.
tests: RB3-A-rerun-files.txt; 25 owned model-free tests + 12 frozen G1 tests passed; two Django compatibility checks skipped. PostgreSQL/API/storage/concurrency/crypto/purge suites authored, not executed per owner restriction.
remaining: Cross-lane core providers, additive migrations/shared registrations/mounts, Postgres acceptance and independent review. No enablement claim.

cross_lane_callable_contracts: core signatures are imported lazily where they are only needed at runtime
accepted_policy: GrantAward.calculation_snapshot pins caps/categories/exclusions/attendance/project/venue policy and UTC claim_due_at; accepted_policy.py reads it. Later programme edits never rewrite accepted terms.
